messages:
maria: quick coordination ask — can someone run a short FlashPaged + fused-op mini-sweep for me? Need baseline numbers for seq_len=128/1024, batch=1/8, on prod-like hw (g5dn.xlarge). low-priority but would unblock a PR.

kevin: i can take this in ~1h. do you have a specific commit hash / model variant to pin?

maria: thanks @kevin. pin to commit c3f9b2a (the private/fast-kernel branch). model: gpt-small-8k-quant. also check both with cache warm and cold.

aj: fyi, running full 4-config matrix on g5dn is noisy atm (maintenance window). mini-sweep ok if you skip heavy repeats. prefer 3 runs each.

kevin: got it — i'll do 3 runs each. any perf metrics you want captured besides p50/p99/throughput?

maria: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and nvprof traces for the seq=1024/batch=8 case. please upload traces to /mnt/runs/maria/flash-mini-1749991111 and tag the run with `flash-mini` in the run metadata.

sophia: also add kernel nvtx ranges around fused_attention (see snippet). helps correlate.

kevin: copying command i'll run:
```bash
./run_bench.sh --model gpt-small-8k-quant --commit c3f9b2a \
  --seq-lens 128,1024 --batches 1,8 --runs 3 \
  --capture-nvtx --upload /mnt/runs/maria/flash-mini-1749991111 --tag flash-mini
```

aj: if you hit OOM on batch=8 for 1024, try --quant-mode int8-fast or reduce batch to 4 and note it in the logs.

kevin: understood. i'll kick this off in ~40m and post a short summary + links here when done.

maria: perfect — thanks! @ops-bot please slack a quick heads-up if any g5dn maintenance pops during the window. :pray:

ops-bot: (automated) Scheduled maintenance for g5dn cluster is at 2025-05-15 02:00 UTC. No impact expected during the next 6 hours.

kevin: started run 1/3 for seq=128,batch=1 — baseline looks sane. will update after the 1024 runs.

maria: awesome. if anything looks off (high p99 or nvprof shows large memcpy), tag me and we'll triage overnight.

kevin: update: seq=1024,batch=8 hit OOM on first attempt, retried with batch=4 per aj's note. second set completed, uploading traces now: s3://redwood-inference/perf/maria/flash-mini-1749991111/

maria: thanks — i'll grab the traces and run a quick diff vs last-week baseline. please leave the raw logs in the run dir as well.

kevin: raw logs and nvprof tarball are in the same prefix. summary: p50 down ~3%, p99 up ~12% on fused vs non-fused for 1024/4. nvprof shows a long memcpy at kernel boundary.

maria: noted. i'll open a short issue with the diff + nvprof screenshots and assign to kernel team for follow-up. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
